target.statement: LOTUS achieves the best average rank (2.2456) across 57 clustering datasets, outperforming KMeans (2.7193), MiniBatchKMeans (2.8772), Birch (3.4737), AgglomerativeClustering (4.8070), OPTICS (5.5965), and DBSCAN (6.2807) in the critical difference diagram.

compute.basis: Requires running AutoML pipeline search (1 hour per dataset) for 57 datasets to build the meta-dataset, then leave-one-out evaluation with GW distance; code is available but meta-dataset may need regeneration.

blockers: Meta-dataset of optimal pipelines for 57 datasets may not be provided, requiring 57 hours of AutoML search
GW distance computation for leave-one-out evaluation across 57 datasets is computationally intensive
title: Automated Machine Learning for Unsupervised Tabular Tasks
